Write \(\alpha=(j,\omega)\) for an element of the finite disjoint union \(\Omega\), and write
\[
 \mathsf{Succ}_{\alpha}(S,\ell,T,\tau)=1
\]
when \(S\in\Pi\), the event \(H_{\mathrm{slice}}(S,\ell)\) has positive mass in the support table returned by \(\mathcal O_{\mathrm{src}}(S)\), \(T\) is a measured-ancestry single-district factor extracted from \(\operatorname{Slice}(S,\ell)\), and \(\tau\) is a valid successful \(\operatorname{IDENTIFY}^{+}\) restriction transcript for the concrete instantiation \(\omega\) of \(C_j\).  All four clauses are well typed by Definitions \(\mathrm{Legal\ protocol\ class}\), \(\mathrm{Measured\ source\ slice}\), and \(\mathrm{Restriction\ transcript}\); positivity and measured ancestry use Assumptions \(\mathrm{Positive\ source\ law}\) and \(\mathrm{Measured\ ancestry}\).

Assume first that the full correctly typed run on \(\mathcal R(E_0)\) accepts.  The target-factorization definition partitions the transformed ancestry into \(C_1,\ldots,C_k\), and the finite branch definition enumerates every assignment and induced equality type in \(\Omega_j\).  Acceptance of the complete exhaustive source search therefore implies, for every concrete branch,
\[
 \forall\alpha\in\Omega\quad
 \exists (S_{\alpha},\ell_{\alpha},T_{\alpha},\tau_{\alpha})
 \text{ represented in }E_0:
 \mathsf{Succ}_{\alpha}(S_{\alpha},\ell_{\alpha},T_{\alpha},\tau_{\alpha})=1.       \tag{1}
\]
Indeed, if (1) failed for some \(\alpha=(j,\omega)\), the complete factor loop would exhaust every decoded source for that concrete branch and return \(\operatorname{FAIL}\), contrary to the premise.  This step uses the completeness/exhaustive-search clause of the stipulated full \(\operatorname{CTFIDU}^{+}\) run; it makes no uniformity assertion.

Because \(\Omega\) and the source collection are finite, choose the lexicographically first witness in (1) for each \(\alpha\).  For a chosen successful call, Proposition \(\mathrm{Fixed\ factor\ obstruction}\) gives \(\mathfrak O(T_{\alpha},C_j)=\varnothing\); otherwise that proposition would make the call fail.  Lemma \(\mathrm{Fixed\ transcript\ size}\) then permits replacement of \(\tau_{\alpha}\) by its canonical finite transcript without changing success.

Create one nonempty switching record for each distinct chosen triple \((S_{\alpha},\ell_{\alpha},T_{\alpha})\), let it own exactly the branches choosing that triple, and attach the corresponding concrete transcript \(\tau_{\alpha}\) to every owned branch.  The ownership sets are disjoint and have union \(\Omega\), because each \(\alpha\) was assigned exactly once.  There are at most \(|\Omega|=M\) nonempty records, and hence at most \(M\) distinct protocols.  Every retained protocol--slice--source triple occurs in \(E_0\), so
\[
 \operatorname{Prot}(E_{\mathrm{sw}})\subseteq \operatorname{Prot}(E_0).          \tag{2}
\]
By the distinct-protocol cost definition and \(c(a)\geq0\) from Assumption \(\mathrm{Binary\ rational\ cost}\), (2) gives
\[
 \operatorname{Cost}(E_{\mathrm{sw}})
 =\sum_{S\in\operatorname{Prot}(E_{\mathrm{sw}})}\sum_{a\in S}c(a)
 \leq
 \sum_{S\in\operatorname{Prot}(E_0)}\sum_{a\in S}c(a)
 =\operatorname{Cost}(E_0).                                                       \tag{3}
\]
Every parsing, legality, support, source-typing, branch-partition, and transcript clause in Definition \(\mathrm{Switching\ operational\ acceptance}\) now holds.  Moreover, for every \(\alpha\), the complete run encounters its retained successful source.  It therefore does not return \(\operatorname{FAIL}\), and \(\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{sw}}(Q,E_{\mathrm{sw}};G)=1\).

Conversely, suppose \(\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{sw}}(Q,E_{\mathrm{sw}};G)=1\).  Its ownership masks partition \(\Omega\).  Hence for every \(\alpha=(j,\omega)\) there is one decoded record satisfying \(\mathsf{Succ}_{\alpha}=1\).  Its triple is retained in \(\mathcal R(E_{\mathrm{sw}})\), so the exhaustive source search for \(\alpha\) succeeds.  This holds for every branch of every factor, and the complete unconditional run therefore accepts.  Notice that the proved quantifiers are exactly
\[
 \forall (j,\omega)\in\Omega\;\exists(S,\ell,T,\tau)\;\mathsf{Succ}_{(j,\omega)}(S,\ell,T,\tau)=1,
\]
which is all the switching construction uses.

Let \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}\) be any accepted switching certificate.  First discard every empty-ownership record.  Such a record supplies no branch witness, so acceptance is unchanged; deleting its protocol can only decrease cost because every \(c(a)\) is nonnegative.  Next split a record owning a set \(K\subseteq\Omega\) into \(|K|\) records with the same protocol--slice--source triple, one for each \(\alpha\in K\).  Distinct-protocol charging implies that this operation leaves cost unchanged.  Since the ownership sets partition \(\Omega\), the resulting certificate has exactly \(M\) singleton-ownership records before coincident records are coalesced, and thus at most \(M\) afterward.

For each successful owned branch, Proposition \(\mathrm{Fixed\ factor\ obstruction}\) and Lemma \(\mathrm{Fixed\ transcript\ size}\) give a canonical transcript with at most \(|T|\leq n\) strict restrictions.  Encode every vertex set by its \(n\)-bit incidence mask.  At each restriction there are at most three such masks and a constant number of delimiters and identifiers; every identifier is drawn from a set of size at most \(n+L+M+2\).  Across at most \(n\) restrictions, padding to \(8(n+1)^2\) identifier-sized fields therefore gives the valid upper bound
\[
 |\operatorname{enc}(\tau_{\alpha})|
 \leq 8(n+1)^2\left\lceil\log_2(n+L+M+2)\right\rceil=b_{\tau}.                 \tag{4}
\]
Graph reachability, bidirected connectivity, and literal equality are recomputed from the structural input, so no unlisted path or law value is hidden in (4).

A singleton-ownership switching record contains an \(m\)-bit protocol mask, an \(L\)-bit slice mask, an \(M\)-bit branch mask, an \(n(1+L)\)-bit labelled-source mask, and one transcript.  Hence
\[
 N_{\mathrm{sw}}
 \leq M\bigl(m+L+M+n(1+L)+b_{\tau}\bigr)=B_{\mathrm{sw}}.                    \tag{5}
\]
Sorting records and choosing the lexicographically first canonical transcript make the encoding canonical.

Now suppose a generic acquired collection \(E_0\) is accepted.  The switching normal-form theorem produces an accepted switching certificate of cost at most \(\operatorname{Cost}(E_0)\), and the preceding canonicalization preserves acceptance, satisfies (5), and does not increase cost.  Thus, for every accepting \(E_0\), at least one accepted binary string of length at most \(B_{\mathrm{sw}}\) has no larger cost.

There are fewer than \(2^{B_{\mathrm{sw}}+1}\) binary strings of length at most \(B_{\mathrm{sw}}\).  The accepted canonical subset is therefore finite.  If the instance is feasible it is nonempty, and exact binary-rational costs have a minimum on it; lexicographic order breaks ties.  Call the resulting certificate \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}^{\star}\).  The domination just proved shows that its cost is no larger than that of any accepting generic acquisition, while (5) gives \(N_{E_{\mathrm{sw}}^{\star}}\leq B_{\mathrm{sw}}\).  Finally, \(M\) is a Cartesian-product branch count, so it need not be polynomial in \(N_{\mathrm{in}}\); the proof yields no such bound.

By the canonical switching-certificate lemma, feasibility supplies at least one accepted canonical certificate of length at most \(B_{\mathrm{sw}}\), and the minimum over that finite set equals the infimum in Definition \(\mathrm{Switching\ optimal\ acquisition\ cost}\).  Enumerate all binary strings of lengths \(0,1,\ldots,B_{\mathrm{sw}}\) in lexicographic order.  Their number is
\[
 \sum_{r=0}^{B_{\mathrm{sw}}}2^r
 =2^{B_{\mathrm{sw}}+1}-1.                                                       \tag{6}
\]
For each string, apply the total parser in Definition \(\mathrm{Switching\ operational\ acceptance}\).  Malformed strings are rejected.  For a parsed certificate, verify the ownership partition of the explicitly enumerated \(M\) branches, protocol legality, catalogue values, the positive support of each used conditioning event, measured ancestry, each concrete restriction transcript, and the complete \(\operatorname{CTFIDU}^{+}\) run.  Cache \(\mathcal O_{\mathrm{src}}(S)\) under the \(m\)-bit mask \(S\); thus every distinct queried protocol is charged once, and all reply bits read by the execution are included in \(N_{\mathcal O}\).

Each local graph or mask operation is polynomial in \(N_{\mathrm{in}}+B_{\mathrm{sw}}\).  Any exhaustive subsearch of the complete finite run ranges over objects encoded by the candidate string or over the \(M\) explicit branches, and is bounded by \(2^{O(B_{\mathrm{sw}})}\).  Multiplying this bound by (6), and accounting linearly for the oracle payload actually read, gives
\[
 2^{O(B_{\mathrm{sw}})}
 \operatorname{poly}(N_{\mathrm{in}}+B_{\mathrm{sw}}+N_{\mathcal O}).          \tag{7}
\]

For every accepted candidate compute
\[
 \operatorname{Cost}(E_{\mathrm{sw}})
 =\sum_{S\in\operatorname{Prot}(E_{\mathrm{sw}})}\sum_{a\in S}c(a)
\]
using exact binary-rational arithmetic, keep the least value, and retain the lexicographically first string on a tie.  The canonical-bound lemma proves that no longer certificate and no accepting generic acquisition has smaller cost.  Therefore the retained string is \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}^{\star}\), its cost is \(\operatorname{Opt}_{\mathrm{sw}}\), and decoding its fixed-width masks and self-delimiting transcripts gives exactly the asserted output.

Let
\[
 \mathcal F_{\mathrm{sw}}
 =\{E_{\mathrm{sw}}:\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{sw}}(Q,E_{\mathrm{sw}};G)=1\}.
\]
If \(\mathcal F_{\mathrm{sw}}\neq\varnothing\), the feasible-case theorem returns \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}^{\star}\) and \(\operatorname{Opt}_{\mathrm{sw}}=\operatorname{Cost}(E_{\mathrm{sw}}^{\star})<+\infty\).  If \(\mathcal F_{\mathrm{sw}}=\varnothing\), the convention in Definition \(\mathrm{Switching\ optimal\ acquisition\ cost}\) gives \(\operatorname{Opt}_{\mathrm{sw}}=\inf\varnothing=+\infty\).  The two cases are disjoint and exhaustive.

The canonical switching-certificate lemma gives
\[
 \mathcal F_{\mathrm{sw}}\neq\varnothing
 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
 \exists E_{\mathrm{sw}}\in\mathcal F_{\mathrm{sw}}
 \text{ with }N_{\mathrm{sw}}\leq B_{\mathrm{sw}}.                              \tag{8}
\]
The switching normal-form theorem further gives
\[
 \mathcal F_{\mathrm{sw}}\neq\varnothing
 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
 \exists E_0\text{ finite and correctly typed such that }
 \operatorname{CTFIDU}^{+}(G,Q,\mathcal R(E_0))\text{ accepts}.                 \tag{9}
\]
Negating (8) and (9) proves both asserted infeasibility equivalences.  The same bounded-string enumeration and cached-oracle analysis as in the feasible-case theorem has running time
\[
 2^{O(B_{\mathrm{sw}})}\operatorname{poly}(N_{\mathrm{in}}+B_{\mathrm{sw}}+N_{\mathcal O}).
\]
When no string is accepted, the algorithm emits only the negative decision, so no output-certificate length is present.

Fix \(\mathcal D_{\mathrm{ord}}\in\mathfrak D_{\mathrm{AEK}}\).  For a set \(B\subseteq V\), the embedded protocol
\[
 S_B=\{s\}\cup\{r_v:v\in B\}\cup\{\rho_v:v\in V\}
\]
contains exactly one fresh-unit SELECT, uses every mechanism at most once, is precedence closed and conflict free, and is physically compatible by Definition \(\mathrm{Ordinary\mbox{-}design\ embedding}\).  Hence \(S_B\in\Pi\).  Its RAND coordinates are independent and uniform, so for every \(b\in\mathfrak X_B\),
\[
 P\{R_B=b\}=\prod_{v\in B}|\mathfrak X_v|^{-1}>0.                             \tag{10}
\]
By the consistency clause of the embedding and the definition of the ordinary labels,
\[
 \operatorname{Slice}(S_B,\ell_{B,b})
 =P_b(V\setminus B)
 =Q[V\setminus B](\,\cdot\,;b).                                                \tag{11}
\]
All vertices are READ, so measured ancestry holds.

Let \(\mathbf B\) be ordinary identifying.  Equations (10)--(11) show that the generic acquired collection containing the distinct protocols \(S_B\), all labels \(b\), and all labelled source districts is exactly the Layer-2.5 translation of \(\mathcal Q_{\mathbf B}\).  Because the translated query has one world and introduces no cross-world variable, the ancestor--district recursion of the complete counterfactual procedure specializes to the ordinary ID recursion on \(\mathcal Q_{\mathbf B}\).  Ordinary identification therefore makes that complete run accept.  The switching normal-form theorem selects one successful source for every concrete branch.  Add an empty-ownership paid-protocol marker for any distinct \(S_B\) not selected by those witnesses; such markers do not enter \(\mathcal R(E_{\mathbf B})\) and do not alter acceptance.  The resulting certificate uses exactly the distinct protocols in \(\mathbf B\), and the zero costs of SELECT and READ give
\[
 \operatorname{Cost}(E_{\mathbf B})
 =\sum_{B\in\{B_1,\ldots,B_t\}_{\mathrm{distinct}}}
   \sum_{v\in B}c(r_v)
 =\sum_{B\in\{B_1,\ldots,B_t\}_{\mathrm{distinct}}}
   \sum_{v\in B}\kappa_v.                                                       \tag{12}
\]

Conversely, let \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}\) be accepted in the embedded catalogue.  Every decoded protocol has a RAND-endpoint set
\[
 B(S)=\{v:r_v\in S\}.
\]
Add every missing zero-cost READ action.  The catalogue has no conflicts, SELECT precedes all actions, and READ does not execute a node mechanism, so this preserves legality and cost and yields the full protocol \(S_{B(S)}\).  If an accepted slice also conditions on READ values \(R=r\), its source law is computable from the full ordinary law because positive-source typing gives a strictly positive denominator and
\[
 P_b(A\mid R=r)=\frac{P_b(A,R=r)}{P_b(R=r)}.                                    \tag{13}
\]
Thus every labelled source used by \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}\) is a marginal or a positive conditional of a member of the full family \(\mathcal Q_{\mathbf B(E_{\mathrm{sw}})}\).  Substituting (13) into the accepted identifying expression shows that this full ordinary family identifies the same single-world target.  Therefore \(\mathbf B(E_{\mathrm{sw}})\) is ordinary identifying.

Coalesce equal RAND-endpoint sets.  With \(w(B)=\sum_{v\in B}\kappa_v\), zero-cost SELECT and READ imply
\[
 \sum_{B\in\mathbf B(E_{\mathrm{sw}})}w(B)
 \leq\sum_{S\in\operatorname{Prot}(E_{\mathrm{sw}})}w(B(S))
 =\operatorname{Cost}(E_{\mathrm{sw}}),                                        \tag{14}
\]
where the inequality can be strict when two different READ masks have the same \(B(S)\).

Let \(\operatorname{Opt}_{\mathrm{ord}}\) be the minimum ordinary design cost.  From (12), every ordinary design gives an accepted switching certificate of the same cost, so
\[
 \operatorname{Opt}_{\mathrm{sw}}\leq\operatorname{Opt}_{\mathrm{ord}}.        \tag{15}
\]
From (14), every accepted switching certificate gives an ordinary design of weakly smaller cost, so
\[
 \operatorname{Opt}_{\mathrm{ord}}\leq\operatorname{Opt}_{\mathrm{sw}}.        \tag{16}
\]
Equations (15)--(16) prove equality of optimum costs and, with the same two constructions, equality of feasibility.  Because the reverse map coalesces protocols only inside the embedded catalogue, it yields no approximation statement for general CTF-RAND, partial-child, precedence, conflict, or reusable-slice instances.

proposed_statement_changes.proposed: For every finite acquired collection \(E_0\) on which the full correctly typed unconditional procedure \(\operatorname{CTFIDU}^{+}(G,Q,\mathcal R(E_0))\) accepts, there exists a branch-indexed switching certificate \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}\) using only protocol--slice--source triples represented in \(E_0\), such that \(\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{sw}}(Q,E_{\mathrm{sw}};G)=1\), \(\operatorname{Cost}(E_{\mathrm{sw}})\leq \operatorname{Cost}(E_0)\), and \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}\) has at most \(M=|\Omega|=\sum_{j=1}^{k}|\Omega_j|\) nonempty records and at most \(M\) distinct protocols.  Each branch \((j,\omega)\in\Omega\) has exactly one owner, and that owner supplies one positive, measured-ancestry protocol--slice--source triple and a finite ancestor--district transcript that succeeds for the concrete branch \(\omega\).  Conversely, every switching certificate accepted by \(\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{sw}}\) induces a complete accepting \(\operatorname{CTFIDU}^{+}\) run on \(\mathcal R(E_{\mathrm{sw}})\).  No exchange of \(\forall\omega\exists\) with \(\exists\forall\) is asserted.
proposed_statement_changes.reason: The original claim exchanges branchwise existence with one source fixed across all branches.  On \(u\leftrightarrow v\) and \(u\to v\), targeting \(\{v\}\), the matching branch has the connected obstruction \(\{u,v\}\) while a nonmatching branch deletes the matching arc and succeeds.  The honest consequence of complete acceptance is therefore one witness per concrete branch, yielding at most \(M=|\Omega|\) records, not one witness per factor.

proposed_statement_changes.proposed:
Put \(m=|\mathcal A|\), \(L=|\mathrm{LIT}|\), \(n=|V|\), \(M=|\Omega|\), and
\[
 b_{\tau}=8(n+1)^2\left\lceil\log_2(n+L+M+2)\right\rceil,
 \qquad
 B_{\mathrm{sw}}=M\bigl(m+L+M+n(1+L)+b_{\tau}\bigr).
\]
If the oracle-instance is feasible, it has a lexicographically canonical accepting switching certificate with at most \(M\) nonempty singleton-ownership records, no empty-ownership record, at most \(M\) distinct protocols, and cost no larger than that of any accepting acquired collection.  Every transcript has at most \(n\) strict restrictions and at most \(b_{\tau}\) bits, so its exact length satisfies \(N_{\mathrm{sw}}\leq B_{\mathrm{sw}}\).  Consequently the lexicographically first minimum-cost switching certificate \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}^{\star}\) exists and satisfies \(N_{E_{\mathrm{sw}}^{\star}}\leq B_{\mathrm{sw}}\).  The branch count \(M\), and hence \(B_{\mathrm{sw}}\), may be exponential in the structural input; no \(k\)-record or polynomial certificate bound is claimed.  Oracle replies remain separately charged by \(N_{\mathcal O}\).
proposed_statement_changes.reason: The polynomial \(k\)-record bound depended on the false quantifier exchange.  Singleton branch ownership gives the valid finite bound \(B_{\mathrm{sw}}\) with \(M=|\Omega|\), which may be exponential in the structural input.

proposed_statement_changes.proposed:
If the independently specified oracle-instance \(\mathsf X_{\mathrm{phys}}=(x_{\mathrm{str}},\mathcal O_{\mathrm{src}})\) is feasible, then the minimum defining \(\operatorname{Opt}_{\mathrm{sw}}\) is attained by the lexicographically first canonical switching certificate \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}^{\star}\).  Exhaustive enumeration of switching certificates of length at most \(B_{\mathrm{sw}}\), with one cached oracle reply per distinct protocol, outputs \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}^{\star}\), its protocol masks, exact \(|\mathrm{LIT}|\)-bit slice labels, source masks, \(M\)-bit branch-ownership masks, and one finite concrete restriction transcript per owned branch.  Its running time is
\[
 2^{O(B_{\mathrm{sw}})}\operatorname{poly}(N_{\mathrm{in}}+B_{\mathrm{sw}}+N_{\mathcal O}),
\]
where \(N_{\mathcal O}\) charges every issued protocol query and every returned law-handle, support-index header, and support-table bit.  The verifier executes complete unconditional \(\operatorname{CTFIDU}^{+}\) on the decoded oracle-backed source collection.  No polynomial certificate bound or bounded-treewidth runtime is claimed.
proposed_statement_changes.reason: Exact optimization remains valid after replacing the unsupported uniform search space by the branch-indexed switching space and replacing \(B_{\mathrm{cert}}\) by the honest finite bound \(B_{\mathrm{sw}}\).  The new claim drops the polynomial certificate implication.

proposed_statement_changes.proposed: Exactly one alternative holds for the oracle-instance \(\mathsf X_{\mathrm{phys}}\): either the feasible-case theorem returns \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}^{\star}\), or \(\operatorname{Opt}_{\mathrm{sw}}=+\infty\).  The latter occurs if and only if \(\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{sw}}(Q,E_{\mathrm{sw}};G)=0\) for every switching certificate of length at most \(B_{\mathrm{sw}}\), and equivalently if and only if no finite correctly typed generic acquired collection makes the full unconditional \(\operatorname{CTFIDU}^{+}\) run accept.  Exhaustive enumeration decides the alternative in time \(2^{O(B_{\mathrm{sw}})}\operatorname{poly}(N_{\mathrm{in}}+B_{\mathrm{sw}}+N_{\mathcal O})\), with one cached source-oracle reply per queried distinct protocol; in the infeasible case there is no certificate-output-length term.
proposed_statement_changes.reason: The finite dichotomy is sound only over the cost-dominating switching normal form.  Its search radius is \(B_{\mathrm{sw}}\), not the unsupported uniform bound \(B_{\mathrm{cert}}\).

proposed_statement_changes.proposed:
For every \(\mathcal D_{\mathrm{ord}}\in\mathfrak D_{\mathrm{AEK}}\), translate \(Q[S_0](s_0;x_0)\) to \(Q=P((S_0)_{x_0}=s_0)\).  For every ordinary identifying collection \(\mathbf B=(B_1,\ldots,B_t)\), the complete family \(\mathcal Q_{\mathbf B}\) and labels \(\Lambda_{\mathbf B}\) yield a switching certificate \(E_{\mathbf B}\) satisfying \(\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{sw}}(Q,E_{\mathbf B};G)=1\) and
\[
 \operatorname{Cost}(E_{\mathbf B})
 =\sum_{B\in\{B_1,\ldots,B_t\}_{\mathrm{distinct}}}\sum_{v\in B}\kappa_v.
\]
Conversely, from every accepted switching certificate \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}\) in \(\iota(\mathcal D_{\mathrm{ord}})\), augment protocols by the missing zero-cost READ actions and coalesce protocols having the same RAND-endpoint set.  The resulting ordinary collection \(\mathbf B(E_{\mathrm{sw}})\) identifies \(Q[S_0](\cdot;x_0)\) and satisfies
\[
 \sum_{B\in\mathbf B(E_{\mathrm{sw}})}\sum_{v\in B}\kappa_v
 \leq \operatorname{Cost}(E_{\mathrm{sw}}).
\]
Therefore the ordinary and embedded switching problems have the same feasibility status and the same optimum cost.  Equality is not claimed certificate by certificate in the reverse direction, because distinct READ masks can duplicate one RAND-endpoint set.  Complexity or approximation consequences transfer only on this explicit ordinary SELECT--RAND--READ image, not to the general physical catalogue.
proposed_statement_changes.reason: An ordinary source family supplies branchwise witnesses but need not supply one concrete slice uniform over all branches.  Switching ownership restores the forward construction.  In reverse, distinct zero-cost READ masks may duplicate a RAND-endpoint set, so coalescing proves only weakly smaller ordinary cost per certificate; the two optimum costs are nevertheless equal.

proposed.name: Branch-indexed switching protocol--slice record \(R_{\mathrm{sw}}\)
proposed.construction: A switching record is \(R_{\mathrm{sw}}=(b_S,b_{\ell},b_K,b_T,(\tau_{\alpha})_{\alpha\in K})\).  Here \(b_S\in\{0,1\}^{|\mathcal A|}\) is a protocol mask, \(b_{\ell}\in\{0,1\}^{|\mathrm{LIT}|}\) is one concrete slice label, \(b_K\in\{0,1\}^{M}\) is the incidence mask of a branch set \(K\subseteq\Omega\), and \(b_T\in\{0,1\}^{V\sqcup(V\times\mathrm{LIT})}\) records one labelled single-district source factor extracted from that slice.  For every owned branch \(\alpha=(j,\omega)\in K\), the record contains a self-delimiting ancestor--district transcript \(\tau_{\alpha}\) for that concrete assignment and equality type.  Its fixed-width part has \(|\mathcal A|+|\mathrm{LIT}|+M+|V|(1+|\mathrm{LIT}|)\) bits.

proposed_core_edits.reason: This record exposes the corrected branch ownership and concrete transcript data.

proposed.name: Branch-indexed switching acquisition certificate \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}\)
proposed.construction:
A branch-indexed switching certificate \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}\) is a lexicographically ordered finite list of switching records.  The nonempty ownership masks \(K(R)\) partition \(\Omega\).  For every nonempty record, its decoded \(S\) lies in \(\Pi\), \(\mathcal O_{\mathrm{src}}(S)\) returns a law handle and exact support table, \(\ell\) names a positive well-typed slice, \(T\) is one measured-ancestry single-district source factor extracted from that slice, and every \(\tau_{\alpha}\) succeeds for its owned concrete branch \(\alpha=(j,\omega)\).  A record may have empty ownership only as a paid-protocol marker; then its label, source, and transcript fields are empty and it contributes no element to \(\mathcal R(E_{\mathrm{sw}})\).  Records sharing a protocol pay its cost once.  The exact encoding length is
\[
 N_{\mathrm{sw}}=\sum_{R\in E_{\mathrm{sw}}}
 \left(|\mathcal A|+|\mathrm{LIT}|+M+|V|(1+|\mathrm{LIT}|)
       +\sum_{\alpha\in K(R)}|\operatorname{enc}(\tau_{\alpha})|\right).
\]
No record is required to use one source or transcript uniformly across two different branches.

proposed_core_edits.reason: The primary certificate must preserve assignment-sensitive source switching and pay once per distinct protocol.

proposed.name: Switching operational acceptance \(\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{sw}}\)
proposed.construction: Derive the canonically ordered finite branch universe \(\Omega\) and \(M=|\Omega|\) from the domain, transformed-ancestry, and literal tables in \(x_{\mathrm{str}}\), and then parse the supplied finite string as switching records.  Return \(0\) for malformed input, malformed masks or identifiers, repeated records, failure of the nonempty branch masks to partition \(\Omega\), an illegal protocol, an inconsistent or out-of-catalogue label, oracle reply \(\bot\), a malformed support index, an undefined or zero-mass event \(H_{\mathrm{slice}}(S,\ell)\), a source mask not extracted from the returned law handle, failed measured-ancestry typing, or an invalid concrete restriction transcript.  An empty ownership record is allowed only as a paid-protocol marker with empty label, source, and transcript fields; its protocol must be legal and its oracle reply must not be \(\bot\).  Otherwise cache one oracle reply for each distinct protocol, construct the complete deduplicated collection \(\mathcal R(E_{\mathrm{sw}})\) from nonempty records, normalize \(Q\), and execute complete unconditional \(\operatorname{CTFIDU}^{+}\) from the first ancestral-set transformation through factorization and exhaustive search over every decoded source.  Return \(1\) exactly when the complete run does not return \(\operatorname{FAIL}\) and, for each owned \(\alpha=(j,\omega)\), the record's fixed protocol, slice, and source together with \(\tau_{\alpha}\) reproduce a successful \(\operatorname{IDENTIFY}^{+}\) branch for that concrete assignment and equality type.  Every source-law or support access is an explicit \(\mathcal O_{\mathrm{src}}\) query charged to \(N_{\mathcal O}\).

proposed_core_edits.reason: The main total predicate must verify a partition of concrete branches and execute the full fixed-source procedure.

proposed.name: Main switching optimal acquisition cost \(\operatorname{Opt}_{\mathrm{sw}}\)
proposed.construction:
Define the main switching acquisition optimum by
\[
 \operatorname{Opt}_{\mathrm{sw}}
 =\inf\{\operatorname{Cost}(E_{\mathrm{sw}}):
          E_{\mathrm{sw}}\text{ is a switching acquisition certificate and }
          \operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{sw}}(Q,E_{\mathrm{sw}};G)=1\},
 \qquad \inf\varnothing=+\infty.
\]
This is an acquisition-cost optimization over source certificates; it is not a scalar identifying functional for \(Q\).

proposed_core_edits.reason: The estimand-functional line must optimize over the corrected primary certificate class.

proposed.name: Canonical switching-certificate bound \(B_{\mathrm{sw}}\)
proposed.construction:
Let \(m=|\mathcal A|\), \(L=|\mathrm{LIT}|\), \(n=|V|\), and \(M=|\Omega|\).  Define
\[
 B_{\mathrm{sw}}
 =M\left(m+L+M+n(1+L)
 +8(n+1)^2\left\lceil\log_2(n+L+M+2)\right\rceil\right).
\]
This is the canonical singleton-branch switching-certificate length bound.  It is finite but need not be polynomial in the structural input.

proposed_core_edits.reason: The sound search radius must include one possible record per assignment-and-equality branch.

proposed.name: Complete-run source collection \(\mathcal R(\cdot)\)
proposed.construction:
From a generic acquired collection \(E_0\), retain one copy of each distinct protocol-mask, label-mask, and labelled-source-mask triple and sort the triples lexicographically.  From a restricted uniform certificate \(E\), do the same for its nonempty factor-ownership records.  From a switching certificate \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}\), do the same for its nonempty branch-ownership records; empty paid-protocol markers contribute no source triple.  In every case the three masks have lengths \(|\mathcal A|\), \(|\mathrm{LIT}|\), and \(|V|(1+|\mathrm{LIT}|)\).  Thus
\[
 N_{\mathrm{src}}=|\mathcal R(\cdot)|
 \bigl(|\mathcal A|+|\mathrm{LIT}|+|V|(1+|\mathrm{LIT}|)\bigr)
\]
for the relevant input collection.

proposed_core_edits.reason: The source decoder must accept switching certificates while preserving the existing generic and restricted uniform cases.

proposed.name: Distinct-protocol cost \(\operatorname{Cost}\)
proposed.construction:
For \(F\in\{E_0,E,E_{\mathrm{sw}}\}\), let \(\operatorname{Prot}(F)\) contain each distinct acquired protocol mask occurring in \(F\), including an empty-ownership paid-protocol marker, exactly once.  Define
\[
 \operatorname{Cost}(F)=\sum_{S\in\operatorname{Prot}(F)}\sum_{a\in S}c(a).
\]
Slices, labelled sources, factors, and branches sharing one protocol incur no additional acquisition cost.

proposed_core_edits.reason: Cost reuse must apply identically to generic, restricted uniform, and primary switching certificates, including paid-protocol markers.

proposed.name: Canonical embedded switching certificate \(E_{\mathbf B}\)
proposed.construction: Let \(\mathbf B=(B_1,\ldots,B_t)\) be an ordinary identifying collection.  Acquire one full SELECT--RAND--READ protocol \(S_B\) for each distinct \(B\), together with all labels in \(\Lambda_{\mathbf B}\) and every canonical labelled single-district source factor of the laws \(P_b(V\setminus B)\).  Run complete unconditional \(\operatorname{CTFIDU}^{+}\) on this finite source collection.  For every branch \(\alpha=(j,\omega)\in\Omega\), choose the lexicographically first successful protocol--slice--source triple and canonical concrete restriction transcript, and make that branch the unique owner of the corresponding switching record, merging records that have the same triple.  Add one empty-ownership paid-protocol marker for any acquired \(S_B\) not used by a nonempty record, merge equal records, and sort lexicographically.  The resulting branch-indexed switching certificate is \(E_{\mathbf B}\).

Every transcript has at most \(n\) strict restrictions and at most \(b_{\tau}\) bits, so its exact length satisfies \(N_{\mathrm{sw}}\leq B_{\mathrm{sw}}\). \[
 2^{O(B_{\mathrm{sw}})}\operatorname{poly}(N_{\mathrm{in}}+B_{\mathrm{sw}}+N_{\mathcal O}),
\]
where \(N_{\mathcal O}\) charges every issued protocol query and every returned law-handle, support-index header, and support-table bit. proposed.statement:
For every \(\mathcal D_{\mathrm{ord}}\in\mathfrak D_{\mathrm{AEK}}\), translate \(Q[S_0](s_0;x_0)\) to \(Q=P((S_0)_{x_0}=s_0)\).  For every ordinary identifying collection \(\mathbf B=(B_1,\ldots,B_t)\), the complete family \(\mathcal Q_{\mathbf B}\) and labels \(\Lambda_{\mathbf B}\) yield a switching certificate \(E_{\mathbf B}\) satisfying \(\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{sw}}(Q,E_{\mathbf B};G)=1\) and
\[
 \operatorname{Cost}(E_{\mathbf B})
 =\sum_{B\in\{B_1,\ldots,B_t\}_{\mathrm{distinct}}}\sum_{v\in B}\kappa_v.
\]
Conversely, from every accepted switching certificate \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}\) in \(\iota(\mathcal D_{\mathrm{ord}})\), augment protocols by the missing zero-cost READ actions and coalesce protocols having the same RAND-endpoint set.  The resulting ordinary collection \(\mathbf B(E_{\mathrm{sw}})\) identifies \(Q[S_0](\cdot;x_0)\) and satisfies
\[
 \sum_{B\in\mathbf B(E_{\mathrm{sw}})}\sum_{v\in B}\kappa_v
 \leq \operatorname{Cost}(E_{\mathrm{sw}}).
\]
Therefore the ordinary and embedded switching problems have the same feasibility status and the same optimum cost.  Equality is not claimed certificate by certificate in the reverse direction, because distinct READ masks can duplicate one RAND-endpoint set.  Complexity or approximation consequences transfer only on this explicit ordinary SELECT--RAND--READ image, not to the general physical catalogue.
